limitations: The original 1900-2100 recommendation and subsequent frozen 1901-2099 API range require an authority decision; this audit does not expand the Contract.
Real-provider boundary checks validate engineering ownership for locked tyme4ts values; they do not independently certify astronomical second-level accuracy.
Provider-thrown errors and malformed provider output triggering Domain RangeError have distinct historical error classification; no classification change is claimed.
The rule baseline remains pending formal expert freezing; this is engineering evidence, not clinical acceptance.
